rankimp: Consensus Ranking of Variable Importance with Uncertainty

Source: R/rankimp-package.R
rankimp-package.Rd

Variable importance rankings depend on the method, the random seed and the resample used to compute them. This package treats every source of importance as a judge expressing a ranking over the predictors, and synthesises those rankings into a Kemeny median ranking with ties. Uncertainty about the consensus is quantified through bootstrap rank confidence sets, top-k probabilities and clustering of disagreeing judges.
